'''Wes Sutermeister''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Cincinnati tournament]] on 24 June 2000 with [[Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|Dantooine Base Ops starting Insurrection]], according to Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d934">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-cincinatti-ohio-6-24-00d934/ cincinatti-ohio-6-24-00], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 25 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-cincinatti-ohio-6-24-00d934/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
